Lyrics: 

I can’t deny this passion and desire
But I know it has to burn me
Standing this close to the fire
What am I supposed to do?
And how am I supposed to choose?
I love ‘em both and I just feel so torn
I love ‘em both and I just feel so torn
The glass that frames the picture crack like ice
The photograph remembers all that we now deny
When halfway seems too much to meet
Across the table too hard to reach
Apples falling from the same tree can roll
Torn apart these loving hearts
That beat and break the same
We share a house divided
And the blood that fills our veins
Brothers turn to strangers
And sons deny their name
Somebody loses either way
And every heart is torn
Torn, torn, torn
Torn, torn, torn
Every heart is torn
Hands that used to hold you clenched in fists
Words that used to soothe you cut you into bits
Are you your brother's keeper now?

Nothing hurts a mother more
Than a family at war

That beat and break the same
We share a house divided
And the blood that fills our veins

And can’t feel each other’s pain
Somebody loses either way
And every heart is torn
Torn, torn, torn
Torn, torn, torn
Every heart is torn
Every heart is torn
Torn, torn, torn
Every heart is torn

snippet.title: Daddy Yankee  en vivo Premio Latin GRAMMY 2026
snippet.description:
Daddy Yankee  en vivo Premio Latin GRAMMY 2026



Daddy Yankee protagonizó uno de los momentos más memorables de los Latin GRAMMY 2026 con una presentación histórica en honor a su reconocimiento como Persona del Año. En un espectacular medley de diez canciones, El Big Boss recorrió los grandes éxitos que marcaron su trayectoria y transformaron la música global, acompañado por invitados especiales como Bizarrap, LL Cool J, Jay Wheeler, Fresh Montana, Bad Gyal, Feid y la superestrella india Diljit Dosanjh. Jay Wheeler interpretó “Ella Me Levantó”, mientras Fresh Montana se sumó a “Con Calma”. Desde “Dura”, “Despacito” y “Gasolina” hasta “POKITO”, su más reciente colaboración, la presentación conectó generaciones, culturas y mercados, reafirmando la vigencia de su legado y su influencia en la música mundial. Una noche que rindió homenaje a quien no solo hizo historia en el reggaetón, sino que continúa escribiendo su próximo capítulo

snippet.title: Gatto | Official Trailer | In Theaters March 5, 2027
snippet.description:
this cat’s on his last life...

Set in the feline-run underbelly of Venice, Italy, Gatto releases exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

Previously announced voice cast members Mark Ruffalo, Laurence Fishburne and Enrico Casarosa (who also serves as director) are joined by Bianca Babaşa as Maja; Sherry Cola as Regina; John Turturro as Capitano Briganti; Rumen Sali Shopov as Papu Janko; Rhys Darby as Focaccia; Isabella Rossellini as Contessa; Natasia Demetriou as Charon; Jamie Demetriou as Plague Doctor; Jason Schwartzman as Vivaldi; Saverio Raimondo as Ugo; Jason Mantzoukas as Rico; Matt Jones as Enzo; Austin Madison as Fishmonger; Beatrice Manfredi as Martinelli; Jesse Andrews as Bartolomeo; Tracey Ullman as Luisa; and Marco Calvani as Maestro Foscari.

The original score for “Gatto” is composed by Academy Award®-winner Dario Marianelli (“Atonement”). The score features violin compositions co-written and performed by renowned Slovak violinist Barbora Botošová.

In “Gatto,” after years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, Nero (voiced by Mark Ruffalo) begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco (voiced by Laurence Fishburne), the local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose – unless Venice gets the better of him first. “Gatto” is directed by Enrico Casarosa and produced by Andrea Warren, the filmmaking team behind the Oscar®-nominated feature “Luca.” 

Additionally, “Loving Dory,” a new animated short from Disney and Pixar set in the world of “Finding Nemo,” will play in theaters ahead of “Gatto.” Ellen DeGeneres returns as the voice of Dory in the short, which follows the forgetful blue tang fish as she finds herself in a hapless “meet-cute” with a plastic bag. Mistaking it for a gentle jellyfish, she's moved by its curious nature and falls head-over-fins in love. But it doesn't take long for her new romantic entanglement to escalate from a little clingy to outright toxic – and in desperate need of intervention! The short is written and directed by Lou Hamou-Lhadj, produced by Mary Alice Drumm and executive produced by Academy Award® winners Pete Docter and Andrew Stanton.

“Gatto” and “Loving Dory” release exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

snippet.title: Xbox 25th Anniversary DISASTER! Everyone HATES New Fable Gameplay Trailer Reveal!
snippet.description:
Xbox's 25th anniversary turned into a disaster. The $999 translucent green 25th Anniversary Xbox Series X sold out in seconds at midnight on the Microsoft Store, with no queue and no Xbox account limit. GameStop sold its stock for $4,950, and eBay scalpers flipped consoles for $1,500 to $2,500, all after Xbox CEO Asha Sharma claimed there was "more demand than consoles available." Then Playground Games dropped four minutes of new Fable gameplay for the anniversary, and fans are calling the Fable reboot generic, mostly walking and cutscenes, with none of the classic British humor, ahead of its February 23, 2027 launch on Xbox Series X|S, PS5, PC and Game Pass. Sharma's anniversary memo says game costs and risk "must change" and that "a small team will be able to build worlds that today demand hundreds of developers," which GameSpot says is about AI even if she won't say it, coming from the former Microsoft CoreAI executive behind Xbox layoffs, studio closures and Xbox Labs. Former Tekken boss Katsuhiro Harada, now head of SNK's VS Studio, said at the Console Game Developers Conference in Seoul, with a senior Xbox official in the audience, that he wishes the Xbox Series S had never been released, calling it "extra work for a slightly weaker child," while CD Projekt Red's Paweł Sasko half-defended it. The one bright spot is that MachineGames confirmed Wolfenstein 3 is in production. Watch this full breakdown of the Xbox 25th anniversary disaster, the Fable gameplay backlash, Asha Sharma's AI memo and Harada roasting the Series S!

Sharma's anniversary memo says game costs and risk "must change" and that "a small team will be able to build worlds that today demand hundreds of developers," which GameSpot says is about AI even if she won't say it, coming from the former Microsoft CoreAI executive behind Xbox layoffs, studio closures and Xbox Labs. Former Tekken boss Katsuhiro Harada, now head of SNK's VS Studio, said at the Console Game Developers Conference in Seoul, with a senior Xbox official in the audience, that he wishes the Xbox Series S had never been released, calling it "extra work for a slightly weaker child," while CD Projekt Red's Paweł Sasko half-defended it. The one bright spot is that MachineGames confirmed Wolfenstein 3 is in production. Watch this full breakdown of the Xbox 25th anniversary disaster, the Fable gameplay backlash, Asha Sharma's AI memo and Harada roasting the Series S!

snippet.title: Goonies Pinball Official Trailer - Spooky Pinball
snippet.description:
HEY YOU GUYS!

The Goonies Pinball is a wide-body pinball machine that takes players deep into the treasure-filled world of the beloved 1985 adventure film, The Goonies!

From the Goon Docks of Astoria to the mysterious underground caverns beneath the Oregon coast, players will get to be a part of every step of this Goonie adventure, including outrunning the Fratellis, collecting "Rich Stuff," playing the Bone Organ, exploring the quarters of One-Eyed Willy, and of course, doing the Truffle Shuffle! Every twist and turn brings players one step closer to discovering the lost treasure of One-Eyed Willy and saving the Goon Docks!

Bringing this adventure to life is an incredible collection of authentic film footage, original movie dialogue, memorable music (including "The Goonies 'R' Good Enough" by Cyndi Lauper), and all the characters and moments that have made The Goonies a fan favorite for over 40 years.

Back at the helm of this adventure is Spooky Pinball's design duo, Spooky Luke and Corwin "Bug" Emery, joined by Luke Peters, combining their love of the film with a wide-body layout packed with flowing shots, interactive mechanisms, hidden surprises, and plenty of Goonie-sized fun!

Artist Christopher Franchi once again brings his incredible talents to the table, creating a stunning art package unlike any of his work you've seen before. It captures the characters, locations, and adventurous spirit of the film perfectly. Brady Hearn returns to deliver an immersive soundscape, while programmers Matt Kemp and Casey Butler bring the entire adventure together through fast-paced gameplay, exciting modes, and countless memorable moments.

So grab your treasure map, gather your fellow Goonies, and prepare for an adventure unlike any other.

Spookies Never Say Die!

snippet.title: Path of Titans: Microraptor Update - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Glide through the trees of Path of Titans as the new playable Microraptor!

Microraptor is among the smallest non-avian dinosaurs, and its four feathered-limbs and light build made it an efficient glider. Use its mobility to descend from the trees and assist the pack in hunting down prey with acquired vocal abilities and healing calls.

https://pathoftitans.com/blog/microraptor-released

Available Now! On PC, mobile and consoles!

Written & Directed by Gage Allen
Produced by Player One Trailers
Music by: Markus Zierhofer
Voiced by: Sam S Hughes

Path of Titans is a cross-platform indie game with MMO questing, where players choose from 30+ dinosaur species and survive, explore, and thrive through life cycle events and social gaming. Find and build a home cave within Riparia, the third of several large maps. Explore our open sandbox, or extend gameplay through an extensive system of MMO questing adventures for the menagerie of air land and sea dinosaurs, with rewards and incentives from egg to adult. Available on Windows, Linux, MacOS, iOS, Android, and all Consoles.

snippet.description:
Official Music Video for "Half Alive." 

Listen to "Half Alive" here: https://TheHungerGames.lnk.to/HalfAlive
Listen to The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (The Album) here: https://www.hungergamessoundtrack.com/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mckennagraceful/?hl=en
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MckennaGraceful
Website: https://www.mckennagrace.com/

Lyrics:

I clean the floor with all the tears left here before me 
Diggin’ my heels into the dirt, won’t fall to my knees  
And all the vultures who want me dead say they adore me 
I’m scared to sleep cause so much changes by the morning 
I’m barely holding on 

My finest ribbons on as I walk to the gallows 
I try but I’m defined by all that I can’t let go 
So call me vile, cruel and bad like I’m an animal 
Tell me to beg and bare my teeth like some sick joke 
Watch as the man plays God 

Won’t hang my head, won’t plead for my life 
They’ll leave me here broken, so just stay by my side 
We feel the unspoken, the look in your eyes 
Promise you’ll hold me, when I’m half alive 
  
I was a sister once, I carry that love closely  
Somehow it haunts me where I go  like that role chose me 
I say I’m mean and tough and I don’t care ‘cause I’m not weak 
But if tomorrow was my last, hope someone mourns me 
Watch as they all applaud 

Won’t hang my head, won't plead for my life 
They’ll leave me here broken so just stay by my side 
We feel the unspoken, the look in your eyes 
Promise you’ll hold me when I’m half alive 

Nobody cares or knows you ‘til you’re just a body 
I fought I pulled away but you, you always saw me 
You’re bruised and bloody, and I’m trying to act softly  
Oh I’m … half alive 

Promise you’ll hold me when I’m half alive 

#MckennaGrace #HungerGames #SunriseontheReaping

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Tyler Crowe - Snakes Don't Shows Their Fangs
snippet.description:
Not everyone standing beside you is standing with you. Some people hide their true intentions behind smiles, friendship, and fake loyalty.

“Snakes Don't Show Their Fangs” by Tyler Crowe is a soulful Southern R&B song about fake friends, hidden jealousy, betrayal, and learning who truly deserves your trust.

Sometimes the closest people are the ones you need to watch the most.

🎧 Listen, feel the message, and share your thoughts in the comments.

Subscribe to Tyler Crowe for more original music.

**Artist:** Tyler Crowe  
**Song:** Snakes Don't Show Their Fangs  
**Genre:** Southern R&B / Southern Soul  
**Release:** Original Music

Full Lyrics 

**[Intro]**

Back in the day, you knew who stood against you.
Now everybody's smiling, everybody's playing nice.
But life taught me one thing...
Not every hand you shake wishes you well.

[Verse 1]
I used to think an enemy would show his face,
Now they sit beside you, smiling in your space.
They ask about your dreams, tell you that they care,
Then turn around and act like you were never there.

I gave a few my trust, I gave a few my time,
Shared my deepest feelings, let them see inside my mind.
They celebrated with me when the good days came,
But when the tables turned, they never stayed the same.

Some people want your sunshine but don't want you to shine,
They'll tell you that they're happy while they're wishing you decline.
I stopped explaining everything I had to do,
Because everybody listening ain't really listening for you.

[Pre-Chorus]
Watch the actions, not the words,
Some lessons have to hurt.
A smile can hide a thousand lies,
And time will open up your eyes.

[Chorus]
Snakes don't show their fangs no more,
They walk right through your front door.
Sit at your table, call you brother,
Then talk against you when they're with another.

They smile when you're winning, disappear when you fall,
Say they'll always be there, never answer when you call.
Everybody talks about loyalty, but few know what it means,
Sometimes the closest faces hide the darkest things.

[Verse 2]
My old man told me, keep your plans inside,
Not everybody wants to see you reach the other side.
Some are asking questions just to learn your next move,
Some are keeping score of everything you do.

They remember every failure, forget the help you gave,
Come around when you're successful, disappear when you need saving.
I used to wonder why the people changed their ways,
Now I understand some only loved my yesterday.

I don't hate nobody, I just learned to see,
Not everybody standing close belongs with me.
I'd rather walk alone than live a life of lies,
A peaceful heart is worth more than a thousand fake replies.

[Chorus]
Snakes don't show their fangs no more,
They walk right through your front door.
Sit at your table, call you brother,
Then talk against you when they're with another.

They smile when you're winning, disappear when you fall,
Say they'll always be there, never answer when you call.
Everybody talks about loyalty, but few know what it means,
Sometimes the closest faces hide the darkest things.

[Verse 3]
I lost a couple friends when I started doing well,
Funny how their attitude was something time would tell.
They liked me when I struggled, when I had nowhere to go,
But when I found my footing, they didn't want to know.

Real friends don't compete with you, they celebrate your name,
They don't make you feel guilty every time you make a change.
They stand beside you quietly when life gets hard,
And never use your weakness to leave another scar.

So I keep my circle small, my expectations low,
I let my actions speak and let the truth unfold.
I don't need a crowded room to prove that I'm alright,
One honest soul is worth a thousand fake goodbyes.

[Bridge]
Listen carefully...

Not everybody who praises you is proud of you.
Not everybody who knows your story deserves to hear your future.
And forgiveness doesn't mean you have to open every door again.

Sometimes moving forward means leaving certain people behind.

[Final Chorus]
Snakes don't show their fangs no more,
They walk right through your front door.
Sit at your table, call you family,
But secretly they wish you weren't where you wanna be.

They smile when you're winning, disappear when you fall,
Say they'll always be there, never answer when you call.
I don't carry hatred, I just finally understand,
Sometimes your biggest enemy is shaking your hand.

[Outro]
The streets taught me to watch for enemies.
Life taught me to watch for fake friends.

I don't wish anybody bad.
I just know who deserves a place in my life.

Because these days...

The snake ain't hiding in the grass.

He's sitting right beside you.

#TylerCrowe #SnakesDontShowTheirFangs #SouthernRnB #SouthernSoul #RnBMusic #SoulMusic

snippet.title: GTA 6 Is 30fps, but We Still Have Questions - Next-Gen Console Watch
snippet.description: Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week, Daemon, Ryan, and Nick take a look at Rockstar's somewhat surprising announcement that GTA 6 will be targeting 30 frames per second on all consoles—including the PS5 Pro. Many gamers, especially those who shelled out the extra bucks for the premium console, were more than a little annoyed that there won't be a 60fps or even 40fps performance mode on the Pro model. Considering the limitations of the Xbox Series X and the PS5 family, is this still acceptable in 2026? Should Rockstar have cut more corners to get 60 frames on the PS5 Pro? Plus we have some choice words from former Tekken boss Katsuhiro Harada about the Xbox Series S, and is Nintendo back in the graphics race following the success of the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake?

Many gamers, especially those who shelled out the extra bucks for the premium console, were more than a little annoyed that there won't be a 60fps or even 40fps performance mode on the Pro model. Considering the limitations of the Xbox Series X and the PS5 family, is this still acceptable in 2026? Should Rockstar have cut more corners to get 60 frames on the PS5 Pro? Plus we have some choice words from former Tekken boss Katsuhiro Harada about the Xbox Series S, and is Nintendo back in the graphics race following the success of the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake?

Check the channel "About" section for the link to the creator of my profile picture.

snippet.description:

Lyrics:
It was Christmas Eve, babe
In the drunk tank
An old man said to me
"Won't see another one"
And then he sang a song
"The Rare Old Mountain Dew"
I turned my face away
And dreamed about you
Got on a lucky one
Came in eighteen-to-one
I've got a feeling
This year's for me and you
So happy Christmas
I love you, baby
I can see a better time
When all our dreams come true

They've got cars big as bars, they've got rivers of gold
But the wind goes right through you, it's no place for the old
When you first took my hand on a cold Christmas Eve
You promised me Broadway was waiting for me

You were handsome, you were pretty, queen of New York City
When the band finished playing, they howled out for more
Sinatra was swinging, all the drunks, they were singing
We kissed on a corner, then danced through the night

The boys of the NYPD choir were singing "Galway Bay"
And the bells were ringing out for Christmas Day

You're a bum, you're a punk, you're an old hag on junk
Lying there almost dead on a drip in that bed
You scumbag, you maggot, you cheap, lousy blaggard
Happy Christmas, your arse, I pray God it's our last

The boys of the NYPD choir, still singing "Galway Bay"
And the bells are ringing out for Christmas Day

"I could have been someone", well, so could anyone
You took my dreams from me when I first found you
I kept them with me, babe, I put them with my own
Can't make it all alone, I've built my dreams around you

The boys of the NYPD choir, still singing "Galway Bay"
And the bells are ringing out for Christmas Day

And the bells are ringing out

Letra

Sí, ya sé
Que ganar lo que yo tengo tiene un precio
Yo así decidí crecer
Me critican y me dicen que ando recio
Creen que uno no sabe que se siente el hambre
Y obligarse a dormir nomás pa' aguantarse
Todo es diferente gracias a mi madre
Que en las malas me ha enseñado a levantarme
Y aunque ahora hay billetes eso no me hace grande
Los lujitos deslumbran a los farsantes
Viejón, ahí voy
Solo deje que termine unos asuntos
Pero ya estamos mejor
A mi amá le compré casa y sin los puntos
Me llena de orgullo verla bien contenta
Siendo que ayer no acabábamos la renta
Pasé de un futuro y una vida incierta
A un presente donde se me abren las puertas
Ya nadie me dice, ya nadie me cuenta
Este mundo nomás es pa'l que se avienta
Y hay que aventarse, viejones

Ya no estoy
Pa' mamadas tampoco pa' chingaderas
Creo que ya les demostré
Que yo estoy corriendo mi propia carrera
En mentes pequeñas no entran sueños grandes
Que era un loco así decían los ignorantes
Dejé atrás los miedos y las limitantes
Me enfoqué nomás en darle pa' delante
Ahora la muñeca llena de brillantes
Fue mi culpa por ser muy terco y constante
Sacrifiqué
Tiempo con familia y también diversiones
Arrepentido jamás
Porque ahorita todo lo disfruto el doble
Carro pa' mi padre y pa' mi amá una casa
Es el resultado de un a ver qué pasa
El que no lo intenta es el que fracasa
Y aquel que no se rinde es el que la cuaja
Yo sigo al tirante con toda mi raza
Dejé claro que los sueños se trabajan
